title: eustachys distichophylla
intro: Eustachys distichophylla, commonly known as the 'Tree of Life' or 'Makahi'a, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Eustachys distichophylla are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic and medicinal properties.
